title: His own recordings: quintet sides, Blanche Thomas and Billy Tircuit
summary: He recorded himself because nobody else would; list of releases.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Record labels, producers and the business of making albums

blocks.x: Yeah, I wanted to be on record. Nobody would record me. I said, well, I'll record myself.
Mm-mm. Yeah, I've got a list of... Yeah, you did a... You did a... A quintet. There's a Wallace Davis, Davenport Quintet. Did two sides. Tippie, part one, and Tippie, part two.
I guess... And then you did a... One record with Blanche Thomas.
And that was... This Love of Mine. This Love of Mine.
I got rid of all that stuff. Not knowing... I should have kept it.
So did... And there was another record with Billy...
Was that a... Green... Green Lizard.
Yeah. Crazy Green Wizard and Face... Face the Facts. Yeah, Face the Facts. Was he a vocalist?
